Control_Statement: Ensure Cloud Storage buckets are not publicly accessible
Control_Description: Verify that no Cloud Storage bucket grants access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers via IAM policy bindings or ACLs

Control_Statement: Ensure Cloud SQL instances require SSL connections
Control_Description: All Cloud SQL database instances must enforce SSL/TLS for client connections to prevent unencrypted data transmission

Control_Statement: Ensure Cloud SQL automated backups are enabled
Control_Description: Automated daily backups must be configured and enabled for all Cloud SQL instances to support disaster recovery

Control_Statement: Ensure default service account is not used for compute instances
Control_Description: Virtual machine instances must not use the default Compute Engine service account to limit lateral movement risk

Control_Statement: Ensure uniform bucket-level access is enabled on Cloud Storage buckets
Control_Description: Storage buckets must use uniform bucket-level access instead of fine-grained ACLs to simplify and strengthen access management
